pyfmo.write_excel2 module#

contribution_mat(orbs, sfos, mos)[source]#
energy_gap_mat(sfos1, sfos2)[source]#
fock_mat(sfos1, sfos2)[source]#
get_molecules(reader)[source]#
orbint_mat(sfos1, sfos2)[source]#
overlap_mat(sfos1, sfos2)[source]#
to_excel(orbs, out_file: str = 'pyfmo.xlsx', sfo_energy_type: str = 'energy')[source]#

Write data about sfos1 and sfos2 to a nicely formatted excel file. Currently writes overlap matrices, square of overlap matrices, energy gap matrices and orbital interaction matrices. Both restricted and unrestricted sfos are supported.
